input_recipe: Repeat the pinned shared 6.708 s H.264/AAC clip using -stream_loop -1 -t 600 -c copy -movflags +faststart. This is a repeated stress fixture, not 10 minutes of independent content.

environments.macos: Apple M1 Max 64 GB, macOS 27.0.1, release
environments.windows: Core i9-12900K 64 GB, Windows 11 x64, release
environments.ios: iPad Air 4 iPadOS 27.0.1, release development signing
environments.web: Chrome 155 headless on the M1 Max, release, single-thread decoder and single-thread ONNX

measurement: One retained final suite per platform; additional three consecutive ten-minute passes on macOS. Memory sampled every 200 ms and recorded around 30 media-second intervals; not a confidence interval or an hours-long soak test.
